The review submission source excludes running headers and footers; accepted-publication output uses the TAPS workflow.
The source permits numbered and author-year placeholders; the selected venue decides which style applies. Do not force numeric citations for every ACM venue.
Only when the venue uses double-blind review: omit author identity and identifying acknowledgments, citations or related-work discussion. This is not a blanket citation ban.
The source contains an unresolved 'xxx characters' placeholder; no numeric character limit is invented.
The first paragraph after a heading uses PostHeadPara; later body paragraphs use Para with a 12pt first-line indent.

coverage_notes: This source describes review submission, not final TAPS publication layout.
Required source fonts are Linux Libertine O and Linux Biolinum O; missing fonts must remain failed/unverified, with no silent Times substitution.
At-least line spacing is an absolute point minimum, not inherited automatic 1.079 spacing.
PostHeadPara has zero first-line indent after headings; general Para has 12pt. Contextual exceptions need host review until explicitly applied.
The guide has an unresolved xxx-character placeholder for figure descriptions; no numerical limit is invented.
Author-year versus numeric citation mode is venue-dependent; double-blind identity restrictions are conditional, not a blanket ban on citation.
Typography and main-text page attributes derive from the pinned Word source; semantic policies retain their source-defined scope.
This fixed source version is not a claim of current compliance with every venue using the publisher's name.
